from.place: clause 4: '$F$ ... reflects isomorphisms (if $F(f)$ is bijective then $f$ is an isomorphism)'

title: Functor reflecting isomorphisms
statement: A functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ *reflects isomorphisms* (is *conservative*) if every morphism $f$ of $\mathcal A$ such that $F(f)$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal B$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal A$. For $\mathcal B=\mathbf{Sets}$: if $F(f)$ is bijective then $f$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Fundamental Groups of Schemes, Definition 0BMY (label definition-galois-category), item (4) and its first footnote
